title: Distributed Online Estimation of Spiked Eigenvalues with Adaptive Weighting under Persistent Aspect Ratio Heterogeneity
summary: We study online estimation of spiked covariance eigenvalues from observations distributed across $L$ nodes with heterogeneous and persistent effective sample sizes. In the proportional high-dimensional regime, local Rayleigh statistics are deterministically distorted by node-specific aspect ratios $c_{\ell,t}=p/N^{\mathrm{eff}}_{\ell,t}$, and direct aggregation of uncorrected statistics converges to the wrong limit. We propose a correct-then-aggregate framework in which each node removes its deterministic bias via an inverse Rayleigh transfer map, and the server fuses corrected estimates…
